name: Pedro Emanuel
scopeNote: Four counted spells: Académica (2011-06-14 to 2013-04-07, Taça de Portugal 2011/12), Apollon Limassol (2015-06-09 to 2016-12-11, Cypriot Cup 2015/16 and Super Cup 2016), Al Taawoun (2018-05-07 to 2019-05-22, King's Cup 2019) and Vasco da Gama (2026-07-10 to ongoing). Dates are the user's decided dates; not re-verified (Sport360 gives Apollon sacking as December 2016). Vasco has by far the best tactical coverage (Lance!, VAVEL, ge, NetVasco, Brazilian press). By 2026-09-19 Vasco had played about 19 matches of the spell (Pedro Emanuel in the Coritiba press conference: 'Dos 19 jogos que fizemos'), so the Vasco spell has more than 15 competitive matches. Académica and Apollon have no match-level tactical source found; Al Taawoun has one data-based source (Sport360, Wyscout). Style terms used by sources: 'construção a três' with volante dropping between centre-backs, three-volante structure (4-3-3 / 4-2-3-1 with ball, 4-1-4-1 without), individual-marking encaixes against Fluminense, counter-attacks via fast wide players. No source calls his Vasco purely zonal or man-marking; the only marking label is VAVEL's 'marcações individuais' for one match. Popular label 'adapts to squad' (NetVasco SEO-style profile) is a generic statement, tier C.
openQuestions: Base formation conflicts: ge/Freitas Lobo and NetVasco profile say 4-2-3-1 and 4-3-3 with a construção a três; Sport360 (2020) says the 4-4-2 was deployed in Portugal, Cyprus and Saudi Arabia. Not reconciled.

Marking: only one match source (VAVEL, Fluminense 2026-08-05) mentions marcações individuais; Lance! says Vasco defended in bloco baixo vs Vitória. Zonal vs man-marking as a general principle is not stated by any source.

Académica 2011/12 and Apollon Limassol: no tactical source found (searches in PT/EN returned only results lists, Wikipedia and RTP cup-final preview). Their tactics rest on the retrospective ge/Freitas Lobo comment about Académica/Estoril/Arouca.

Spell start dates and the 2012-05 cup-final preview quote come from a second source only partly (RTP); appointment dates for Académica, Apollon and Al Taawoun were taken from the user's decision and not re-checked.
Set-pieces: only two Vasco quotes about corners (Santa Fe 2026-09); no source on routines or taker/zonal-man set-piece defence.
Lance! 2026-08-05 piece says all four of his titles came in knockout competitions; not used as a tactical fact.

sources.title: Confira como costumam jogar os times dirigidos pelo português Pedro Emanuel (ge via NetVasco)
sources.evidence: Ele gosta mais que as equipes peguem o jogo desde trás, tradicional, os centrais abrirem, para depois o volante baixar para pegar nessa construção, uma dita construção a três. Depois, com laterais bem projetados e médios conseguem uns mais recuperadores, outros mais construtivos e avançados que atacam bem a profundidade, gostam muito de ir nas costas dos defensores. Essa é a imagem que o Pedro deixou sobretudo no futebol português, nos tempos da Académica, do Estoril
